# Vendored library licenses

## lamejs / LAME

`lame.min.js` is a JavaScript port of the LAME MP3 encoder.

- Project: <https://github.com/zhuker/lamejs>
- LAME: <https://lame.sourceforge.io/>
- License: GNU Lesser General Public License (LGPL), version 3 or later.

The library is used unmodified as a separate JavaScript file and is loaded only when an MP3 export is requested.

## mp4-muxer

`mp4-muxer.mjs` is an MP4 muxer for WebCodecs.

- Project: <https://github.com/Vanilagy/mp4-muxer>
- License: MIT.

The library is used unmodified as a separate ES module and is loaded only when an MP4 or M4R export is requested.
